name: one-c-erp-diagnostics
description: Evidence-first 1C:ERP diagnostics with Gate 1-10 orchestration, domain skills, adversarial verification, and safe action control.

interface.longDescription: Evidence-first 1C:ERP diagnostics for movements, registers, postings, month close, cost, expenses, settlements, VAT, warehouse/series/assignments, production, access rights and supplied code. The workflow routes the case, builds a causal chain, runs an independent adversarial verification pass, and proposes the smallest safe action with before/after validation.
defaultPrompt: Diagnose this 1C:ERP incident through Gate 1–10 and do not claim a root cause without evidence.
Compare the correct and problematic 1C:ERP examples, find the earliest proven divergence, and verify the conclusion adversarially.
Проверь этот инцидент 1С:ERP по Gate 1–10 и не делай финальный вывод без доказательств.
